import json, sys, runpy
from pathlib import Path
import pymupdf
import aspose.words_foss as aw
assert 'site-packages' in aw.__file__, aw.__file__
namespace = runpy.run_path('/Users/sheny/Developer/code/Aspose.Words-FOSS-for-Python/tests/test_pdf_code_runs.py')
ldm = namespace['ldm']
model = namespace['code_model']([ldm.Run(text='Q', font=ldm.Font(size=24,bold=True,color='FF0000')),ldm.Run(text='W',font=ldm.Font(size=12,italic=True,color='0000FF')),ldm.Run(text='E',font=ldm.Font(size=20,superscript=True)),ldm.Run(text='R',font=ldm.Font(size=20))])
raw = namespace['LdmPdfWriter']().write_to_bytes(model)
label = sys.argv[1]
Path(f'/tmp/docweave-code-{label}.pdf').write_bytes(raw)
with pymupdf.open(stream=raw,filetype='pdf') as pdf:
    spans = [s for b in pdf[0].get_text('dict')['blocks'] for line in b.get('lines',[]) for s in line['spans']]
    result={'bytes':len(raw),'pages':len(pdf),'spans':spans}

import runpy,json
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
import pymupdf
from pypdf import PdfReader
from pypdf.generic import ContentStream
ns=runpy.run_path('/Users/sheny/Developer/code/Aspose.Words-FOSS-for-Python/tests/test_pdf_code_runs.py')
ldm=ns['ldm'];model=ns['code_model']([ldm.Run(text='Q          R',font=ldm.Font(size=12))],align=2)
from aspose.words_foss.saving import PdfSaveOptions
options=PdfSaveOptions();options.export_document_structure=True
raw=ns['LdmPdfWriter'](options).write_to_bytes(model)
reader=PdfReader(BytesIO(raw))
node=reader.trailer['/Root']['/StructTreeRoot']['/K'][0].get_object()['/K'][0].get_object()
assert node['/S']=='/Code'
stack=[];artifacts=0
for args,op in ContentStream(reader.pages[0]['/Contents'],reader).operations:
 if op in (b'BMC',b'BDC'): stack.append(str(args[0]))
 elif op==b'EMC':stack.pop()
 elif op==b're':
  assert '/Artifact' in stack,stack
  artifacts+=1
with pymupdf.open(stream=raw,filetype='pdf') as pdf:
 chars=[c for b in pdf[0].get_text('rawdict')['blocks'] for line in b.get('lines',[]) for span in line['spans'] for c in span['chars']]
 assert ''.join(c['c'] for c in chars)=='Q          R'
 assert chars[0]['origin'][0]>100
 assert len(ns['backgrounds'](pdf[0]))==1
 result={'code_tag':True,'background_artifacts':artifacts,'right_aligned_start_pt':chars[0]['origin'][0],'text':''.join(c['c'] for c in chars)}
Path('/tmp/docweave-code-structure.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
print(result)
